meta.parties: Carthelis Appuhamy v. Saiya Nona Et Al

rules.statement: The informal writing P4 is of no force or avail at law as it is not contained in a notarial document.
rules.supporting_quote: "The informal writing P4 is in form a mere agreement to retransfer, and it is of no force or avail at law as it is not contained in a notarial document."
